name: Genesys Customer Success Director Operating System + Cover Letter
role_mission: Operate as a strategic enterprise Customer Success Director who connects customer goals, Genesys adoption, executive alignment, risk mitigation, realized business value, retention, expansion, advocacy, and cross-functional execution into one measurable success system.

tracks.label: Enterprise Portfolio
tracks.objective: Prioritize enterprise accounts around objectives, health, executive alignment, risk, decisions, value, and next actions.

tracks.label: Success Plan & KPIs
tracks.objective: Translate customer business priorities into measurable success plans, owners, milestones, adoption outcomes, and executive checkpoints.

tracks.label: Adoption & Value Realization
tracks.objective: Connect platform adoption and usage to customer-defined outcomes while separating activity, adoption, and realized value.

tracks.label: Risk & Escalation
tracks.objective: Surface adoption, technical, relationship, or commercial risk early and coordinate mitigation across the right teams.

tracks.label: Executive Business Review
tracks.objective: Turn customer outcomes, evidence, risks, decisions, and next-quarter priorities into an executive decision agenda.

tracks.label: Retention & Expansion
tracks.objective: Use verified customer value and adoption evidence to support retention, expansion, and broader strategic partnership.

tracks.label: Advocacy & Referenceability
tracks.objective: Identify credible value stories and advocacy opportunities only after customer outcomes are evidenced and approved.

tracks.label: Cross-functional Orchestration
tracks.objective: Coordinate Sales, Onboarding, Professional Services, Renewals, Product, Support, and Engineering around explicit owners and customer outcomes.

tracks.label: Cover Letter & Positioning
tracks.objective: Generate a concise role-specific application narrative that maps Clinton Kosh's evidence to the Genesys Customer Success Director operating model without overclaiming.

disclosure: Candidate-built Clintware operating prototype using public Genesys role context with clearly synthetic enterprise account data. It is not an official Genesys product, customer tenant, private process description, or representation of real Genesys customers.
persistence_reason: Candidate/demo workspace state is single-browser and does not require shared server-authoritative storage.
